proposal.reason: Main change is in IB transport connection setup: optional AFED symbol loading and round-robin TX affinity assignment across LAG ports for send data QPs during NET send-QP bring-up. Include gin because proxy GIN connection behavior is explicitly specialized (only qps[0] is treated as a data QP for affinity/slot consumption), which is a substantive GIN-specific networking policy change rather than a purely mechanical caller edit.
